title: Simply Better
description: A simple modpack that adds vanilla+ features but not the bloat and not any controversial features
body:
# **SIMPLY BETTER**
The definitive Vanilla+ experience for players who want a better game without the bloat.
[Modpack Name] is a carefully curated collection of mods designed to enhance the core Minecraft experience while staying true to the original game's feel. This pack is built for players who want modern features and peak performance without "controversial" overhauls or heavy, resource-draining content.

## **Key Features**
    True Vanilla Feel: No complex machinery, magic systems, or radical gameplay changes that feel out of place.
    Pure Quality of Life: Includes essential tweaks that make the game smoother, like better inventory management and informative tooltips.
    Lightweight & Optimized: Designed to run smoothly on low-to-mid-range PCs by focusing on modern rendering and logic optimizations.
    Resource Friendly: We’ve excluded heavy features to ensure your game loads fast and maintains high FPS.
    Ready for Multiplayer: Optimized to work seamlessly on servers with minimal impact on TPS.

## **Technical Details**
This pack is built on the Fabric loader and focuses on stability and performance. We have purposefully avoided "bloatware" mods to provide a clean, "plug-and-play" experience for everyone.

## **Included Resources**
This pack comes pre-configured with optimized settings and supports high-quality resource packs out of the box, ensuring your game looks and feels very good from the first launch.
